Name: Deeplink Launcher
Description: Open any deeplink (URL scheme) such as slack://, obsidian://, zoommtg:// or https:// with a key press.

Actions.Name: Open Deeplink
Actions.Tooltip: Open a deeplink (URL scheme) when the key is pressed

Localization.Opens the link with the app registered f: Opens the link with the app registered for its scheme, e.g. slack://, obsidian://, zoommtg:// or https://.
Localization.Spaces and non-ASCII characters are perc: Spaces and non-ASCII characters are percent-encoded automatically.
Set a deeplink URL for this key first.
Localization.The URL must start with a scheme such as: The URL must start with a scheme such as myapp://
Localization.No app is registered to open this kind o: No app is registered to open this kind of link.
